messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager (SEV-2) — elevated model warmup failures reported across gpu-nodepool-eu-west starting ~11:12 UTC. Error signature: deserialization OOMs and occasional CUDA kernel launch timeouts. Alert: <https://monitoring/redwood/alerts/2103507777>

Maya Patel: I'm oncall. Devon, can you give quick scope? Is front-door impacted or just background warmups?

Devon Reyes: seeing ~18 warmup failures/min. Most are from background warmup workers but some user-initiated first requests are hitting the same path and failing with 500. Front-door retries are masking some errors — a few customers see elevated 5xx.

Arjun Singh: snippet from failing loader:

```
2026-03-15T11:13:01Z modelloader[pid=2245]: deserializing weights chunk 4/12
2026-03-15T11:13:01Z modelloader[pid=2245]: allocate_gpu(324MB) -> cuMemAlloc: out of memory
2026-03-15T11:13:01Z modelloader[pid=2245]: warning: falling back to host pinned memory
2026-03-15T11:13:02Z modelloader[pid=2245]: compile_kernels() timed out after 60s
kube: container restart, CrashLoopBackOff
```

Arjun Singh: appears to be two correlated problems: big transient alloc spikes during chunked deserialization causing OOM, then compile step hangs when kernel cache is contended.

Lisa Gomez: kube events show GPU driver resets on node 10.20.3.45 and 10.20.3.46 around the same time. Those nodes then experienced multiple pod restarts.

Maya Patel: deploy-bot, please pause any active model rollouts in eu-west.

deploy-bot: model rollouts paused in gpu-nodepool-eu-west. :white_check_mark:

Tom S.: quick mitigations we can try:
- switch warmup to streaming-deserialize (lower peak alloc)
- throttle concurrent warmup tasks per node to 1
- if needed, route new requests to quantized variant (lossless for our customers so far)

Devon Reyes: streaming-deserialize toggle exists behind runtime flag. We can flip it cluster-wide but it's risky for in-flight loads.

Maya Patel: customer impact — Elena, which customers are affected?

Elena (Customer Success): spotted errors for BlinkAI (some prompt completions failed), ParcelSync (embedding batches failed), DataFjord (alerts about latency spikes). BlinkAI saw ~22 failed requests in last 15m; ParcelSync had 3 failed batches.

Maya Patel: severity remains SEV-2 (partial outage). I'm creating ticket INC-2103507777 and will own comms. Adding oncall handoff plan.

Arjun Singh: I'll try the streaming-deserialize on a small canary (5% traffic). Also increasing compile timeout to 180s for canary to see behavior.

Tom S.: I'm going to drop concurrent warmup workers from 4 -> 1 on affected nodes to reduce contention.

Devon Reyes: doing that now via k8s job patch. Expect pods to restart as they pick up new env.

Lisa Gomez: cordoning node 10.20.3.46 due to repeated driver resets. Draining warmup pods off it.

Arjun Singh: canary toggles applied: `runtime.warmup_streaming=true, runtime.compile_timeout_ms=180000` to 5% of warmup traffic.

Arjun Singh: canary logs: no deserialization OOMs so far, compile timeouts still rare but down. Warmup failure rate on canary = 0.4% (from 9%).

Devon Reyes: rolling the streaming-deserialize to 50% over 6m. Monitoring OOMKilled events.

Maya Patel: handoff — I'm going off now, Devon you'll be primary for next 90m. Ping me for customer escalations.

Devon Reyes: taking over. Setting repeat page every 4m. I'll coordinate with Eng-Runtime for allocator follow-ups.

Elena (Customer Success): prep message draft for affected customers:

"We detected model load errors affecting some requests in EU-West. We have applied mitigations that reduce memory pressure by switching to streaming deserialization and throttling concurrent warmup tasks. You may experience slightly longer cold-starts; inference correctness is unchanged. If you need logs or a bridge, reply and we'll arrange it." 

Maya Patel: looks good, send to BlinkAI and ParcelSync. Offer bridge to DataFjord if they request.

deploy-bot: streaming-deserialize rolled to 100% on gpu-nodepool-eu-west and compile timeout increased cluster-wide for warmup pods. :rocket:

Devon Reyes: after the roll, warmup failure rate down to 0.6% cluster-wide. GPU driver resets stopped on cordoned nodes. No customer-data exposure detected.

Arjun Singh: next actions: implement allocator improvement to avoid large transient pinned allocations during deserialization; add a soft memory cap for warmup sidecars; create e2e warmup stress test that simulates fragmented memory.

Tom S.: also add a guard: if a node reports >3 compile timeouts within 15m, auto-cordon for mitigation and alert the SREs.

Elena (Customer Success): BlinkAI acknowledged and scheduled a 20m sync. ParcelSync accepted the note. DataFjord asked for more detail, scheduling a call.

Maya Patel: owners: Arjun -> root cause and patch, Devon -> monitoring/dashboards and follow-up, Lisa -> node health and driver telemetry, Elena -> customer comms/post-incident calls. We'll run RCA and postmortem within 72h.

Devon Reyes: logging final state: incident remains open for RCA, immediate mitigations completed, customer impacts limited and communicated. I'll update ticket INC-2103507777 with timeline.

Maya Patel: thanks everyone. If anything regresses, repager immediately. :pray:

Devon Reyes: copying logs to incident thread: `/var/log/modelloader/warmup-2026-03-15.log` and metrics snapshot uploaded to the incident runbook.

Maya Patel: :wave:
